events.name: Pikachu Marathon
events.summary: Walk 5, 10, 21 and 42 km for a Pikachu encounter.

events.name: AEON Mall Halloween
events.gameTitle: AEON Mall Halloween Event 2026 Timed Research
events.summary: Spin, evolve, use berries, walk, send gifts, throw curveballs, win a raid and complete field research for Witch Hat Pikachu.

events.name: Pokémon Night Out
events.gameTitle: Pokémon Night Out Timed Research: Low Key Form
events.summary: After the Low Key or Amped choice: win a raid, evolve, spin 20 stops, use 10 berries, power up 5 times and make 10 Great Throws for Toxtricity. Page 1 of the stream research (10 spins, 10 catches, 5 berries) gives Umbreon. Every venue's research (Los Angeles, then London at The O2 on 2026-11-10) shares the TR_NIGHT_OUT_2026_ prefix.

events.name: Halloween Pikachu
events.summary: Six tasks that are already done when granted, a Rare Candy each, then a Halloween Pikachu.

events.name: Festival of Lights
events.summary: India only. Page 1: spin a stop, then choose Pikachu wearing a kurta or a saree. Page 2: spin 5 different stops, 3 berries, catch 5 species, battle in a raid, send 5 gifts with a sticker. Page 3: catch on 3 different days, catch 15 species, evolve 5, battle in 3 raids, 10 Great Throws, for the chosen Pikachu and the Sparkler Pose.
